text.description_html:
Laurey 39428, Midtown Cabinet Knob in Satin Nickel

The Satin Nickel Midtown Cabinet Knob has a unique style that is well-suited to rustic and tuscan home decor designs, the Midtown Cabinet Knob in Satin Nickel is sure to represent your style. The Midtown Cabinet Knob has a 1-1/4 inch diameter with a 1 inch projection. The Rustic Midtown Satin Nickel Cabinet Knob comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet knob is part of the Laurey Midtown Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 39428 Satin Nickel Midtown Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Available finishes:
Satin Nickel Matte Black / Terra Cotta Wash

Sold Individually
